title: Port the approved native Watch app design
outcome: Port the approved native Watch app design.

included: Native Watch picker, timer, controls, goal and summary screens adopt the approved navy, amber and teal visual language.
Existing persist-first commands, exact time, goal semantics, Crown paging, privacy redaction, accessibility identifiers and large text accommodations are preserved.
excluded: Persistence, wire contracts, signing and version allocation.
